recall.minute: Word + context = meaning: I went to the bank (to withdraw money / watching ducks). Lexeme = entry; lemma = citation form; sense = meaning; synset = synonym group {intelligent, clever, bright, brilliant, smart}. Homonymy: unrelated (bat cricket/mammal, match game/pairing); polysemy: related (paper; mouth of person/river/cave). Synonyms (big/large; not big → large brother), antonyms (hot/cold, rich/poor), hypernym/hyponym (vehicle → car → SUV; car is both), meronym (wheel, steering wheel → car; finger → hand). Nouns: hypernymy, meronymy; verbs: move → walk, sleep → snore (troponymy), entailment; adjectives: antonymy. WordNet: lexical database as a graph; bat₁ mammal → animal; bat₂ sports equipment → artifact; inheritance, meaning by position, map for WSD. WSD methods: MFS (80/20 bat); Naive Bayes with add-1 over V = 6 (fin: 0.8 × 5/16 × 3/16 = 0.0469; riv: 0.2 × 1/11 × 1/11 = 0.0017; ≈ 28×); embedding similarity (sentence vs gloss cosine, modern default); Lesk overlap (loan ~ loans → finance; fisherman/bass 0 vs 0 → extended Lesk, stemming, richer glosses, embeddings).
